This data set contains the eleven (11) scans collected to document the effects of dismantling the Perrenoud Homestead due to safety concerns. This data is the forth of five data sets. The data was collected with the Z+F 5010X by the Capture2Preserve Team on July 25 2017. This was the third day of dismantling the homestead. The data was processed with Laser Control v. 8.9
